title: Understanding the Regression Coefficient
text: In a linear regression model, each coefficient represents the change in the dependent variable for a one-unit change in the corresponding independent variable, holding all other variables constant.

title: Focus on the Soda Consumption Variable
text: The coefficient \(\hat{\theta}_1\) is associated with the variable \(x_1\), which represents whether an individual drinks soda. Consider how this affects blood sugar levels.

title: Holding Other Variables Constant
text: Remember that in a regression model, the interpretation of a coefficient involves holding other variables constant. How does this apply to \(\hat{\theta}_1\)?

hintAnswer: \hat{\theta}_1 is the predicted increase in blood sugar for someone who drinks soda relative to someone who does not drink soda holding type $$2$$ diabetes status constant.
title: Interpreting \(\hat{\theta}_1\)
text: What does \(\hat{\theta}_1\) tell us about the relationship between soda consumption and blood sugar levels?
